_source: app_config (V21, V25) and the services that read it. Where code now decides a value instead of app_config, the note on that value names the code.
name: QuickLocal
slogan: Fresh from local shops to your doorstep
intro: QuickLocal connects you with trusted local vendors, fast deliveries, and reliable services — all in one place.

delivery._source: SearchService / HomeFeedService: the customer's browse radius defaults to 4 km and is clamped to 4–20 km; V112__address_delivery_radius.sql stores the customer's own choice per address as one of 4/8/12/16/20; checkout refuses anything beyond 20 km (fees.json maxDistanceKm). app.max_delivery_time_hours is the 3-hour ceiling.

referral._source: app_config: referral.reward_amount_inr (V25), read live by ReferralService. Applied as a discount on the referrer's next order once the friend's first order qualifies.

_removed: app.min_delivery_fee (₹15) and app.platform_fee (₹10 flat) are still rows in app_config, but no code reads either any more: delivery starts at the ₹30 base in fees.json, and the platform fee is a per-category percentage charged to the shop — the customer never pays one. The rider fallback payout (20 / 5 / 30) is explained in fees.json _rider.
